free_tier.stated: Kilo Code: "Platform plan | Free for individuals" and for inference "Choose free models, local models, BYOK, Kilo Gateway, or Kilo Pass", with "AI inference stays at provider rates with no markup", quoted

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: a free VS Code agent with a free-model route is a $0 front end to whichever inference vendor is giving tokens away, so it inherits that vendor's quota and needs no card of its own.
limits_note: nothing binds on the platform itself; the ceiling is whichever model the free-model route serves that hour.
binding_note: nothing binds on the platform itself; the ceiling is whichever model the free-model route serves that hour.

evidence.proved: "Platform plan | Free for individuals" and "AI inference | Choose free models, local models, BYOK, Kilo Gateway, or Kilo Pass", quoted
cloud compute is a separate metered line, quoted as "Usage-based compute for cloud features, charged separately from inference"

notes: The page does not name which models the free route serves or how many requests it allows. kilo.ai/docs/code-with-ai/platforms/free-models returned 404, so the number that would settle this record is not published at the URL.
